profile.headline: Sr Staff Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Engineering leader with strong mathematics background and a passion for building reliable services, data & analytics platforms, graph theory, measurement, and creating happy teams. Energized by collaboration, finding insights in data, diving into complexity, defining strategy, efficient execution, and fundamentals. Leading efforts to bring new ideas to market and optimize platforms at top tech firms for over 15 years.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical Lead - Big Query Site Reliability

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Principal Engineer for Microsoft Security's Applied Research team, which incubates new applications of AI to the security industry.

positions.title: Principal Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Engineering Manager for Project Science Engine (MSR) & Project Sophia (BAP)

Group engineering manager overseeing the teams responsible for runtime services, AI serving, data, language, connectors, and security & compliance. Unified teams and created a culture based on shared efforts, respect, transparency, and engineering excellence. Coached ICs and leads both hands on and by creating communication and cooperation among peers. Navigated graduation of Project Science Engine, taking a team of engineers to BAP’s Project Sophia to accelerate and productionize that incubation effort. Ensured the team was able to land safely, get earned promotions, and find their way in the new organization.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Platform Architect for Project Science Engine (MSR), an incubation product that provides a data and AI platform served through an extensible analytics engine and canvas that was adopted by a handful of fortune 500 companies.

Drove team engineering culture by developing the engineering design process, defining the live site process, leading retrospectives, founding an engineering excellence team, and maintaining architectural docs & records. Drove production readiness by working with PM and engineering leads to define and drive roadmap based on pillars of engineering and product fundamentals. Designed and drove stateless, distributed runtime services with a transactional data model. Designed service and storage architecture for fully integrated product copilot and drove iterative improvements in quality of LLM suggestions through evaluation metrics and experimentation. Collaborated with data science team to define and implement ML Ops process to ship production ready models.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
Display Ads - Display & Video 360, Google’s enterprise portal for large advertisers to manage campaigns.

TL for campaign insights.
Took over and revitalized a legacy system using a customer focused, measurement driven strategy. Redefined interaction paradigm & redesigned UX to improve actionability, increasing engagement 6x. Cut pipeline run times in half, and improved maintainability by refactoring for testability and removing low value, largely unused legacy features. Expanded insight library and tool entry points for additional increases in engagement.

Lead engineer on effort to improve relevance of DV360’s publisher search.
Analyzed customer behavior to design relevance & satisfaction metrics. Researched and developed ML models for contextually ranking publishers for advertisers. Designed systems for ingesting and curating data, and training, validating and serving ML models which improved relevance 5x. Identified bottlenecks in serving and reduced latency by 30%.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Bing Maps
Took over and restructured transit directions to reduce latency by 60%, improve overall result quality, and reduce LoC in the transit code base by 50% while improving testability and unit test coverage.  Designed and developed solutions to get transit directions on Bing search page.  Refactored core directions code to reduce latency by 13% and increase capacity by 45%.  Added multi-point to multi-point directions functionality and API.  Standardized team measurement process and on-boarded pipelines to core bing technology.  Drove adoption of scrum-style planning and execution on team.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Power BI
Engineer on team which developed online data search for Excel/PowerBI. Designed & developed framework for offline relevance experiments. Used offline and online data to drive relevance improvements. Led team of 8 engineers to improve deployment story of service. Pushed for data driven culture, shaping team’s measurement story in both relevance and BI. Created libraries for controlling user exposure, including a/b testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Bing - ExP
Worked on online experimentation for Bing. Focus on developing tools which provide automated analysis and guidance to experimenters. Own, maintain, and continuously improve the experiment quality monitoring system for Bing. Co-Instructor for Microsoft's "Introduction to Experimentation" course.

positions.title: Mathematician III
positions.description: Create and verify mathematical models of gaming machines.  Develop specialized algorithms and software to perform large calculations and simulations. Train teammates in advanced mathematical and computing concepts. Design and develop software tools to improve team performance (including automation tools and calculation libraries). Work with management on designing metrics, data analysis, and process improvement.  Manage tool building projects (including design and development of team sharepoint site, and design, development, and maintenance of team database).

positions.title: Visiting Assistant Professor
positions.description: Maintaining research agenda, Creating and delivering original lectures, Creating and grading exams and quizzes, One on one assistance for students, Maintaining grades and records, Creating special topics courses, and Advising senior projects.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Creating and delivering original lectures, Creating and grading exams and quizzes, One on one assistance for students, and Maintaining grades and records.
